import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int round = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine().trim());
        String[] firstperson = scanner.nextLine().trim().split(" ");
        String[] secondperson = scanner.nextLine().trim().split(" ");

        solve(round, firstperson, secondperson);
    }

    public static void solve(int round, String[] firstperson, String[] secondperson) {
        int win = 0;
        // Append first element of secondperson to the end
        String[] secondpersonExtended = Arrays.copyOf(secondperson, secondperson.length + 1);
        secondpersonExtended[secondperson.length] = secondperson[0];

        for (int i = 0; i < firstperson.length; i++) {
            int fp = Integer.parseInt(firstperson[i]);
            int spNext = Integer.parseInt(secondpersonExtended[i + 1]);
            int sp = Integer.parseInt(secondperson[i]);

            int findless;
            if (fp <= spNext) {
                findless = fp;
            } else {
                findless = spNext;
            }
            win += findless;
        }

        // Remove the appended element
        // (No need to explicitly delete in Java, just ignore)

        // Insert the third element of secondperson at the start
        String[] secondpersonModified = new String[secondperson.length];
        secondpersonModified[0] = secondperson[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < secondperson.length; i++) {
            secondpersonModified[i] = secondperson[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < firstperson.length; i++) {
            int fp = Integer.parseInt(firstperson[i]);
            int sp = Integer.parseInt(secondpersonModified[i]);
            int spNext = Integer.parseInt(secondpersonModified[(i + 1) % secondpersonModified.length]);

            if (fp > 0) {
                int diff = Math.min(fp, sp);
                fp -= diff;
                sp -= diff;
                firstperson[i] = Integer.toString(fp);
                secondpersonModified[i] = Integer.toString(sp);

                if (fp > 0) {
                    diff = Math.min(fp, spNext);
                    fp -= diff;
                    spNext -= diff;
                    firstperson[i] = Integer.toString(fp);
                    secondpersonModified[(i + 1) % secondpersonModified.length] = Integer.toString(spNext);
                }
            }
        }

        int sumFirstPerson = 0;
        for (String s : firstperson) {
            sumFirstPerson += Integer.parseInt(s);
        }

        System.out.println(sumFirstPerson + " " + win);
    }
}
